description.en: Your private partnership pipeline: brands you approach, status, follow-ups and journal. The people are linked from your address book. Has no public page.
description.fr: Votre suivi privé des partenariats : marques démarchées, statut, relances et journal. Les personnes sont reliées depuis votre carnet d'adresses. N'a aucune page publique.

label.en: Days without news before a follow-up is due
label.fr: Jours sans nouvelle avant qu'une relance soit due

mcp.name: partners_list
mcp.description: List the partnership files (brands being approached) with status, chances and whether a follow-up is due. Use it to find a brand; people are not listed here: they live in the Contacts module (contacts_list).

mcp.name: partner_get
mcp.description: Read one partnership file: its fields, its journal and the people linked to it (id, name, role, email). The people themselves are kept in the Contacts module: use contact_get there for their phone, notes and full card.

mcp.name: partner_create
mcp.description: Create a partnership file for a brand (status a_contacter or discussion only). To add a person to it, create or find them in the Contacts module first (contacts_list, contact_create), then call partner_link_contact.

contact.description: Generic way to reach the brand (switchboard, website form). Not for people: use the Contacts module.

mcp.name: partner_update
mcp.description: Update the prospecting fields of a partnership file (status, chances, brief…). The 'contact' field is only for a generic way to reach the brand; people are attached with partner_link_contact, not typed here.

contact.description: Generic way to reach the brand (switchboard, website form). Not for people: use the Contacts module.

mcp.name: partner_log
mcp.description: Add a dated journal entry to a partnership file (exchange, decision, next step). Notes about a person, whatever the brand, go to the Contacts module (contact_note).

mcp.name: partner_link_contact
mcp.description: Attach a person who already exists in the Contacts module to a partnership file (does nothing if already attached). Find or create the person in Contacts first (contacts_list, contact_create); never retype their details here. Reversible with partner_unlink_contact.

contact_id.description: Contact id from the Contacts module.

mcp.name: partner_unlink_contact
mcp.description: Detach a person from a partnership file. The person is NOT deleted: they stay in the Contacts module. To delete a person, use contact_delete there.

mcp.name: partner_delete
mcp.description: Permanently delete a partnership file together with its journal. The people linked to it are NOT deleted: they stay in the Contacts module. Irreversible. Off by default: an administrator must grant it to a token.

label.en: The address book (Contacts module): people live there, partnerships only link to them
label.fr: Le carnet d'adresses (module Contacts) : les personnes y vivent, les partenariats ne font que s'y référer
